answer: Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. The vine explorer shows the whole merge tree. Splitting into 6 separate vaults requires a separate funded garden account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. That is 16 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
